title: fix(platform-objects): the Register SSO Provider form names the userinfo endpoint, reads claims from the ID token only, and suggests the Entra ID email claim
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBBMRz58sooyjh7uzbfgc81M)_

Fixes #32297

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → SSO 提供方 → **注册 SSO 提供方** 表单新增两个可选字段：Userinfo URL（`userInfoEndpoint`）和“仅从 ID 令牌读取声明”（`skipUserInfo`，名称与列 `skip_user_info` 一致）；Discovery URL 与 Userinfo URL 改为 `url` 输入，并说明在此填写的端点会被该提供方信任；邮箱 claim 的提示文字写明 Entra ID 的映射（`preferred_username` 或 `upn`）。
- 为什么改：#32296 之后服务端已接受这些字段，但表单发不出来：Entra 管理员读到“请填写该端点”的拒绝却无处可填，无邮箱用户只能去翻文档找映射。
- 风险与回滚：只是新增可选参数（widening），不填时请求与以前完全相同；邮箱 claim 从不替管理员自动填写，留空仍映射 `email`。无服务端改动、无 `packages/spec` 改动。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts` 的 `register_sso_provider` 参数，然后看 `mapEmail` 上方说明为什么提示是静态文字。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/platform-objects.test.ts -t 32297`，预期 1 条通过；控制台用例：在 `ui/` 下 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.createUserRequiredField-28289.test.tsx -t 32297`，预期 3 条通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。与 #32268 改同一对象文件和翻译包，谁后落地谁合并 `main` 并重新生成。

## What changes

`sys_sso_provider.register_sso_provider` (Setup → SSO Providers → **Register SSO Provider**) gains the fields the register bridge has read since #32296. The names are measured from the bridge, not assumed: `runRegisterSsoProviderFromForm` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts:128-129, 211`) reads `body.discoveryEndpoint`, `body.userInfoEndpoint` and `body.skipUserInfo` (`true` or `'true'`), and passes the first two into `oidcConfig` under the same names and the third at the top level of `/sso/register`.

| Param | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `discoveryEndpoint` | `text` → `url` | Existing. The help text now says `(https)` and adds the trust sentence. |
| `userInfoEndpoint` | `url`, optional | New. Kept instead of the endpoint the discovery document names. |
| `skipUserInfo` | `boolean`, optional, no default | New. Labelled "Read Claims From the ID Token Only", as the `skip_user_info` column and Edit Sign-In Options already are. |
| `mapEmail` | unchanged | The help text names the Entra ID mapping. |

**Does `discoveryEndpoint` need the trust sentence? Yes.** `AuthManager.ssoDiscoveryTrustedOrigins` (`auth-manager.ts:5458-5485`) trusts the issuer, `oidc.discoveryEndpoint` and `oidc.userInfoEndpoint` alike for the registration that names them. So both endpoint help texts carry "An endpoint named here is trusted for this provider." That is the remedy `explainUntrustedDiscoveryEndpoint` names in its refusal.

**The Entra hint is static help text. Why:**
- I checked what an action param can declare (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, `ActionParamSchema`). `helpText` is a template over `record` only, and the dialog's own values are not bound (`ACTION_PARAM_HELP_TEXT_TEMPLATE_DESCRIBE`).
- A param's `visible` predicate reads `current_user` / `data` / `features`. The console evaluates it against `usePredicateScope()`, not against the dialog's state (`ActionParamDialog.tsx:674-685`).
- `defaultValue` is a literal that is submitted verbatim. No key reads another param's value, so a hint keyed on the issuer host the admin types cannot be declared.
- The honest minimum is a static `helpText` on `mapEmail` that names the issuer host and the mapping, as the SAML rows already do. It needs no renderer feature and no `packages/spec` change.
- The claim is never set for the admin. A conditional hint would need a spec key that binds dialog values into `helpText` or `placeholder`. That is listed under Acceptance notes, not done here.

The labels and help texts are regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` and translated by hand in all ten locale bundles. The changed `discoveryEndpoint` and `mapEmail` help texts are re-translated too, so no stale translation stays behind. No echo rows are added: the CJK bundles translate "Userinfo URL" as well.

## Why

After #32296 an Entra ID admin who registers from Setup gets a refusal telling them to name `userInfoEndpoint`, in a form that has no such field. Users without a mailbox then fail to sign in until someone finds the `preferred_username` mapping in the docs. The server half is merged. This is the console half the triage of #32147 split off.

## Verification

- **Object pin** (`packages/platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts`, "register_sso_provider collects the fields the register bridge reads, under the bridge's names (#32297)"):
  - the full param list by name, type and required, in order;
  - no default on `skipUserInfo` or `mapEmail`;
  - the `mapEmail` help text names `login.microsoftonline.com` and `"preferred_username"`;
  - both endpoint help texts carry the trust sentence.
- **Console case**, added as a top-level `describe` to the shared action-runtime harness `useConsoleActionRuntime.createUserRequiredField-28289.test.tsx` (ruling record 6583487846). It uses the real `ActionRunner`, the console runtime's api and param handlers, the real `ActionParamDialog` and a real `I18nProvider`:
  - the dialog draws Userinfo URL, Discovery URL and the opt-out checkbox (unchecked), and shows the Entra hint while the email claim input stays empty;
  - an Entra-shaped registration (Entra issuer, Graph userinfo URL, `preferred_username`, opt-out ticked) posts to `/api/v1/actions/sys_sso_provider/register_sso_provider` with `userInfoEndpoint`, `skipUserInfo: true` and `mapEmail` under the bridge's names;
  - control: left alone, the opt-out is not sent as on and no email claim is sent.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each mutation landed, anchor 1 → 0, and the file was restored to HEAD):

| # | Mutation (`sys-sso-provider.object.ts`) | Went red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `name: 'userInfoEndpoint'` → `'userinfoEndpoint'` | the #32297 object pin |
| A2 | Entra sentence deleted from the `mapEmail` help text | the #32297 object pin |

- **Runs** (under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`):
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects` full suite: Test Files 121 passed (121), Tests 1954 passed (1954)
  - the console harness file: 14 passed (14)
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects run typecheck`: exit 0
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0
  - `eslint` on the changed object, pin and harness files: exit 0
  - `check-i18n-bundles`: OK
  - `check-i18n-stale-fill`: OK (no new stale fills)
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: 69 derived, 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, exit 3: its fixture is pinned to a commit a shallow clone cannot reach). Every other command exited 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`. Head `9c700de0`.
  - `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` (commit `8f9f31b7`): the two passages naming `userInfoEndpoint` and `skipUserInfo` on the register bridge now also name the form fields that fill them (**Userinfo URL**, **Read Claims From the ID Token Only**). The 30 doc families this edit adds to `dispatch-gates --commands` (`check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, spec `check:docs`, `check-adr-links`, …) each exited 0, and so did `check:doc-authoring`, `check-affected-docs` and `check-drift-comment`.

## Acceptance notes

- A conditional hint, shown only when the issuer host is `login.microsoftonline.com`, needs a spec key that binds the dialog's own values into a param's `helpText` or `placeholder`. Today none does (see What changes). Carrier: none. It belongs to the seat to file if wanted. `packages/spec/**` is out of this card's scope.
- The form offers `discoveryEndpoint` and `userInfoEndpoint` only. The server's remedy table (`REGISTRATION_MEMBER_OF`) also names `authorizationEndpoint`, `tokenEndpoint` and `jwksEndpoint`, which the bridge does not read. Observation only, no reach measured.
- Serial with open PR #32268 (#32085): it edits the same object file and the translation bundles. Whichever lands second merges `main` and regenerates.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (no `packages/spec` change)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is the project's required maintainer summary)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
